quests.title: A Special Selection

dialogue.section: Yarovaya, Nervous Young Person, Applicant B

dialogue.t: What are they doing?
Ready... Go!
Not good enough. There's no way you can complete the mission if your skills aren't up to par.
For real? Come on, I really need this opportunity!
I'm sorry, but this is a matter of life and death. We cannot entrust such a dangerous mission to unqualified personnel.
Next!
Looks like they're recruiting some crack shots...

dialogue.sit: Is this a new recruitment drive?

dialogue.t: Yeah. From what I've heard, it's not a routine one. The standards this time are much stricter.
If this was how they ran every callup, the Druzhna would've disbanded long ago due to a lack of recruits.
Then why are so many people still showing up?
Because the pay's good, man! I heard that if you make it through, you even get some... chronic crystal, or whatever it's called!
Next!
I'm up... Coming!
Kristall, huh? That stuff's in high demand. Are they really just dishing it out to new recruits?

dialogue.sit: As a member of the Rokot...

dialogue.t: Paimon's with you! You're a shoo-in with your shootin' skills! You're gonna win some Kristall and share it out among the villagers, right?
Hehe, this is definitely a job for the Rokot! Let's do it!
Next!
Ah, it's our turn...
P—Pass!
Aw, yeah!
Pardon my curiosity, but... have you entered the Shadow Realm before?
Please follow me first.
Judging by the look of your firearms, you must be familiar with the Shadow Realm and well aware of the dangers within.
My superiors would like me to send some personnel into the Shadow Realm to eliminate the danger and prevent it from affecting the outside world.
With this device, we can transport you right into the target zone. After that, all you'll have to rely on are the abilities you've just demonstrated.
So that's what this mission is...
Yeah! Is there any Kristall to be had?
Hmm? Ah. You must have heard the rumors spreading among the applicants. It seems that's what they consider the highest reward.
In fact, the terms I am authorized to offer state that, in addition to the highest-level stipend, you may requisition a batch of supplies needed to complete your mission.
As long as it's within the Druzhna's power, we will prioritize procuring it for you.
In that case... we're gonna want some Kristall!
Hmm... That can be arranged. But could you tell me exactly what you need it for?
Uh...

dialogue.sit: I'm giving it to those in need.

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}...
I see... Well, if it's a dealbreaker, then I can accept your terms.
Ma'am. I am here to report that we've found a suitable candidate.
It shames me to say that the Druzhna have grown severely short-handed of late. Ordinarily, we should be the ones to complete a mission like this.
Don't blame yourself. Her Majesty arranged this "special recruitment project" precisely to deal with situations of this kind.
Snezhnaya is a great nation, and Her Majesty is confident that there is great talent hidden among the populace. Our task is to find it.
Yes, Ma'am.
Furthermore, do not forget that we have other things in mind for these new recruits beyond simply pitching in where the official forces are unable to.
Do you think any of the candidates selected in this round show sufficient potential to take on the Tsaritsa's edict?
Funny you should mention that. I think you might want to read this candidate's registration profile. He(She) might be just the person we need.
Him(Her)? Huh, isn't that interesting...
{NICKNAME}? Never mind. Forget I asked.

quests.description: As you pass by the Druzhna HQ, you notice a very special selection process underway…
